rules.statement: A claim for fees for teaching falls under section 11 of the Prescription Ordinance and is not prescribed for three years.
rules.supporting_quote: "There are other cases (1 Lorenz 22 and 115: 2 Lorenz 67; 4 S. C.C. 47). Bawa. for respondent,-Section 9 applies, as the section says nothing about manual work only (2 Thomson's Institutes, p. 194). The cases from Lorenz applied to artisan's wages. This is a claim for work done."
